user.title: Connect to Omnesis
user.description: Address of your Omnesis gateway. With the Omnesis add-on on this server, keep the default.

data_description.url: The gateway's https address and port (7600 unless you changed it), or a Tailscale name.

certificate.title: Trust the gateway's certificate
certificate.description:
The gateway at {url} uses a self-signed certificate with this SHA-256 fingerprint:

`{fingerprint}`

Compare it with the gateway's own: the Omnesis add-on prints it in its log at start, and `omnesis tls status` shows it as `fingerprintSha256`. Submit only if they match: Home Assistant will trust this certificate alone.

pair.title: Pair Home Assistant
pair.description: In the Omnesis portal open **Settings → Devices → Pair device**, choose kind **Integration**, name it `Home Assistant` and pick the access level its answers may use. Paste the code here.

access_level.title: Choose an access level
access_level.description: Home Assistant is paired, but its device has no access level yet, so Omnesis cannot answer it. In the Omnesis portal open **Settings → Devices** ({portal_url}), pick the access level on the Home Assistant device's card, then submit.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Omnesis
reauth_confirm.description:
Home Assistant could not use its connection to {url}. If the certificate fingerprint below is new, check it against the gateway's before you continue:

`{fingerprint}`

If Home Assistant's device was revoked, pair again and paste a new integration code; otherwise leave the code empty.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the gateway at this address.
error.not_omnesis: Something answered at this address, but it is not an Omnesis gateway.
error.invalid_url: Enter the gateway's https address and port.
error.insecure_url: Use https; plain http is only allowed for this machine.
error.invalid_pairing_code: The code was refused. It may be mistyped, already used, expired (codes last 10 minutes), or not an Integration code.
error.token_refused: The gateway refused Home Assistant's token. Pair again with a new code.
error.certificate_changed: The gateway's certificate changed during setup. Start again.
error.access_level_required: Home Assistant's device still has no access level that can answer. Choose one in the Omnesis portal: Settings → Devices ({portal_url}).

data_description.answer_timeout: How long one question may take, retries included. Voice satellites may give up sooner.

ask.name: Ask
ask.description: Asks Omnesis a question and returns its answer.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: Which Omnesis gateway to ask, when more than one is set up.

token_refused.message: The gateway refused Home Assistant's token; reconfigure the Omnesis integration.

certificate_changed.message: The gateway's certificate changed; reconfigure the Omnesis integration to trust the new one.

answer_timeout.message: Omnesis did not answer within {seconds} seconds.

invalid_response.message: Omnesis answered in a form this integration does not understand.

no_loaded_entry.message: No Omnesis gateway is set up and running.

entry_required.message: More than one Omnesis gateway is set up; choose one.

access_level_required.message: Choose an access level for the Home Assistant device in the Omnesis portal: Settings → Devices ({url}).

access_level_unavailable.message: The access level chosen for Home Assistant can no longer answer; choose another one in the Omnesis portal: Settings → Devices ({url}).

access_level_required.title: Omnesis needs an access level for Home Assistant
access_level_required.description: {title} is paired, but its device has no access level yet, so Omnesis refuses to answer. Open the Omnesis portal at **Settings → Devices** ({url}) and pick the access level on the Home Assistant device's card. Home Assistant reconnects by itself; no new pairing code is needed.

access_level_unavailable.title: Omnesis access level for Home Assistant cannot answer
access_level_unavailable.description: The access level chosen for {title}'s Home Assistant device can no longer answer. Open the Omnesis portal at **Settings → Devices** ({url}) and choose another level on the device's card. Home Assistant reconnects by itself; no new pairing code is needed.
